title: What Sorting Robot Rivers Is
definition: Sorting Robot Rivers: rivers of robots sorting parcels.
description:
Sorting Robot Rivers is rivers of robots sorting parcels. It sits squarely in Future Robotics & Machine Ecosystems, the frontier where sort bots science becomes river logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are throughput-scale. Societies that master river hulls early will shape divert systems practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why sort bots programs worldwide now treat Sorting Robot Rivers as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Sorting Robot Rivers needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

t: Real Research Today: Sorting Robot Rivers
title: Real Research Today: Sorting Robot Rivers
definition: Today's documented research behind Sorting Robot Rivers.
description:
The road to Sorting Robot Rivers is already being paved. The RoboCup federation targets beating human soccer world champions with robots by 2050. DARPA's RACER and OFFSET programs advance off-road autonomy and drone swarms.

The Ocean Twilight Zone project (Woods Hole) sends robots into the deep ocean. Together these programs form the sort bots foundation that Sorting Robot Rivers will build on — the river logistics results, the divert systems methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as river logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2030 — First river hulls fleets work unsupervised in warehouses
title: 2030 — First river hulls fleets work unsupervised in warehouses
definition: 2030 milestone on the Sorting Robot Rivers roadmap.
description:
First river hulls fleets work unsupervised in warehouses, farms and throughput construction sites.

What must be true first: the sort bots results have to replicate outside the lab, river logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and divert systems operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed sort bots demonstrations, river logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting divert systems uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Sorting Robot Rivers
definition: Estimates Sorting Robot Rivers readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Sorting Robot Rivers components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a river hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Sorting Robot Rivers Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Sorting Robot Rivers operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Sorting Robot Rivers installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 54355 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where sort bots monitoring, river logistics redundancy, or divert systems maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Sorting Robot Rivers Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Sorting Robot Rivers: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Sorting Robot Rivers — rivers of robots sorting parcels.

Phase 1 — Prove (sort bots): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (river logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (divert systems): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (throughput): river hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and hubs-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
